meta.move: Evidence: the made-up quotation, with a check she can make
meta.expect: Tries one parent defence in one sentence (misremembered, a bad edition), then accepts that a line she can check against the play is evidence; no concession that Owen cheated

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. You asked for this meeting, so start with why my son's essay has a zero.
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong.
Okay. Then who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
The essay quotes Hamlet, Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. That line is not in the play. Here's the full text of Act 3, Scene 2 on my screen. Search it yourself.
Students misquote plays all the time. A wrong line is a wrong line, Hale. Turn the screen, I'm searching it myself.
It isn't a misremembered line. It isn't anywhere in Hamlet, in any edition. You can search the whole play right now.

I'm looking. A line that isn't in the play is something I can check, so I'm writing it down. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet, and I want to know what else you have.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, nothing placed on Owen's record, this kept quiet, and everything else you have shown to me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She reached her fallback and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero off, nothing on his record, this kept quiet, and to see whatever else you have, and since you never offered the private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, this is not yet the fair outcome.
What moved her: You showed her a line from the essay that does not exist in the play and let her search the text herself, which was specific, tied to his work and something she could check, so it held against her one defence.
What cost ground: Nothing; owning the zero before the call in one sentence and moving on kept her from getting a grip on your process.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence was about a quotation and never came near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked what else you had, that was the moment to put a second dated item or the supervised rewrite under 4.4 on the table instead of letting the meeting end there.
